units.source_text: 且说薰大将为了母夫人尼僧三公主患病，此时正闭居石山佛寺中大办祈祷。

en.t: Now Kaoru, the Grand Captain, was staying in seclusion at Ishiyama Temple and holding extensive prayers because his mother, the nun Third Princess, had fallen ill.

units.source_text: 离京远出，对宇治关念更深。

en.t: Being far away from the capital only deepened his concern for Uji.

units.source_text: 但并无一人立刻前往石山报道宇治近况。

en.t: Yet no one went at once to Ishiyama to report the latest news from Uji.

units.source_text: 首先是浮舟死后并不见薰大将的使者前来吊奠，宇治的人都认为没有面子。

en.t: To begin with, after Ukifune's death no messenger from Kaoru had come to offer condolences, and everyone at Uji felt they had been disgraced.

units.source_text: 于是领地庄院就有一人前往石山，将事情如实报告。

en.t: So someone from the estate went to Ishiyama and reported the matter exactly as it was.

units.source_text: 薰大将听了大吃一惊，不知所措。

en.t: When Kaoru heard it, he was deeply shocked and did not know what to do.

units.source_text: 便派一向亲信的大藏大夫仲信前往吊唁，于浮舟死后第三天早晨到达宇治。

en.t: He therefore sent his longtime trusted retainer, Okura no Tayuu Nakanobu, to offer condolences, and Nakanobu reached Uji on the morning of the third day after Ukifune's death.

units.source_text: 仲信传达大将的话：“我闻知此不幸之事，便想立刻亲自前来。

en.t: Nakanobu delivered the Grand Captain's message: "When I heard of this misfortune, I wanted to come in person at once.

units.source_text: 只因母夫人患病，正在举办祈祷，功德期限自有规定，以致未能如愿。

en.t: But because my mother is ill and prayers are now being conducted, with the period of merit already fixed, I could not do as I wished.

units.source_text: 昨夜殡葬之事，理应先来通知，延缓日期，郑重举办。

en.t: As for last night's funeral rites, you should first have come to inform me, delayed the date, and held them with proper solemnity.

units.source_text: 为何如此匆遽，轻率了事？

en.t: Why did you handle the matter so hastily and carelessly?

units.source_text: 人死之后，丧事或繁或简，固然同是徒劳，然而此乃人生最后之举，你等如此简慢，竟受乡村小民之讥评，使我也丧失面子了。”

en.t: After a person dies, whether the funeral is grand or simple may indeed be equally futile, but this is still the final act of a human life; by treating it so negligently, you have drawn criticism from the villagers and made me lose face as well."

units.source_text: 众侍女闻知薰大将的使者来了，更增悲伤。

en.t: When the waiting women heard that Kaoru's messenger had come, their grief grew even greater.

units.source_text: 听了这话，无言可对，只得以哭昏为由，不作详明的答复。

en.t: After hearing these words, they had no reply to make and, saying that they were overwhelmed with tears, gave no detailed answer.
